title: Clearer roster planning and protected saves
summary: Review staffing and workload by month, with clearer shortages and stronger server-side write protection.
changes: Adds month navigation, a current-month shortcut and an all-published-months view to Full roster.
Shows staffing shortages, unresolved allocations and effective staff workload with Saturday/Sunday counts.
Finds professional names and absence records with accent-insensitive roster search.
Closes direct clinical table writes so saves must use the guarded server functions.
Keeps existing rotation, historical allocations, authentication and change history intact.
